name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It guarantees visibility on monochrome and low-contrast displays while meeting WCAG AAA standards. The trade-off is slightly larger visual weight, but this ensures keyboard users with visual impairments can reliably track focus.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on high-DPI mobile screens where 4px collapses to 2px, making it nearly invisible. A 3px ring at 5.5:1 contrast balances visibility on monochrome displays with mobile sharpness—test it on a 1080p phone at arm’s length to settle the argument.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 5.5:1 contrast. It keeps the ring sharp on high-DPI mobile screens where 4px blurs to 2px, while still passing WCAG AA for most users. The trade-off is a slightly lower contrast ratio on monochrome displays, but this is outweighed by reliable visibility on mobile and touch devices. Test it on a 1080p phone at arm’s length to confirm the balance.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 5.5:1 contrast risks failing users with low vision who rely on high-contrast focus indicators. Test a 2px ring at 6.5:1 contrast—it stays sharp on high-DPI screens while meeting WCAG AAA on monochrome displays. Settle it by measuring visibility on a 1080p phone at arm’s length and a grayscale e-ink reader.
